body: - G-Py-11: test_porcelain_dirty_paths_preserves_ordinary_arrow_filename uses `# type: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]` with no inline reason (python/tests/review/test_review_and_fix.py). The guideline requires a reason comment — e.g., `# type: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]  # testing internal helper directly`. All other aspects are compliant: G-Fix-2 is satisfied by three new git-fixture tests reproducing the #7073 scenarios (clean-collected noop, partial-dirty commits-subset, untracked-nested-file); G-Fix-1 is satisfied by addressing the full class; G-Py-14 fake_run helpers carry full type annotations; the stage-paths wire format is unchanged (G-Wire-1).
